svg.title: Yantra-CPU
svg.desc: Yantra-CPU: A 32-bit CPU designed and built from the ground up, as an educational, design-first project. MIT, 3 commits. The panel works the binary number 10110011 from Module-0.md, adding the weights of its set bits, 128 + 32 + 16 + 2 + 1, to reach 179, above a row of 8 modules of which 2 are written.

g.text: A 32-bit CPU designed and built from the ground up, as
2 of 8 modules written, next: The instruction set
